product.title: Girona & Costa Brava Small-Group Tour with Pickup from Barcelona

description.text: See a new side of Catalonia—and make exploring beyond Barcelona city limits hassle-free—on this small-group or private trip to Girona and the Costa Brava. In Girona, explore the Old Town on foot, and discover many of the city's most important landmarks along the way. Stops include Girona Old Town, Pals, Calella de Palafrugell. You'll also visit medieval Catalonian villages like Pals and Calella de Palafrugell, and take in coastal Mediterranean views. Ideal for visitors basing in Barcelona who want a guided city experience without coordinating metro routes, attraction tickets, or landmark timing on their own.
